subject.title: Tracking: cross-process orphan-sweep TOCTOU in provider Cleanup paths (apple-container / local-container / external / apple-vm)

question: Should the apple-vm snapshot-and-CAS hardening in https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1151 be accepted as the security boundary for the remaining tracked Cleanup race, while incus receives a separately scoped repair?
rationale: The remaining work changes destructive cleanup ownership behavior and preserves lease-associated key state, so a human must approve the security boundary and cleanup semantics.

options.title: Review and land apple-vm, then track incus separately
options.body: Accept the narrow apple-vm repair after security review and require a linked, independently reviewed incus fix before closing this tracker.

options.title: Require a consolidated audit before landing
options.body: Pause the apple-vm repair until maintainers define and verify a repository-wide rule for every unguarded claim-removal cleanup path.

recommendation.title: Review and land apple-vm, then track incus separately
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow apple-vm repair after security review and require a linked, independently reviewed incus fix before closing this tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the maintainer follow-up identifying the unresolved apple-vm path and have adjacent cleanup-hardening history.
